shapeLanguage: Preserve measured source geometry without adding an unproven style claim.

silhouetteHierarchy.guidance: Keep the source silhouette legible at the intended viewing distance.

detailScale.guidance: Retain measured detail scale and do not synthesize decorative detail.

materialLanguage: Retain measured PBR evidence and authored materials.
lightingIntent: Use world-level lighting; the asset contributes no independent lighting claim.
antiGoals: Do not infer style from a filename or source folder.

shapeLanguage: Readable faceted silhouettes with simplified organic masses and deliberately low polygon density.

silhouetteHierarchy.guidance: Keep trunks, canopies, rock masses, and groundcover clusters readable at world scale.
Preserve the few large angular breaks that distinguish variants without adding fine noise.

detailScale.guidance: Use broad color blocks and authored facets; avoid microdetail that competes with the silhouette.

edgeTreatment: Retain authored hard-edged low-poly facets and clean silhouette transitions.
materialLanguage: Use the authored matte color-blocked materials with restrained highlights and no synthesized surface wear.

surfaceVariation.guidance: Retain authored color variation; add no compiler-authored mottling.

exclusions: Do not add edge wear or dirt during catalog realization.

lightingIntent: Read as matte stylized outdoor forms under world-level lighting.
antiGoals: Do not infer interchangeability from the shared visual family.
Do not smooth away the authored faceted silhouette.
Do not replace authored materials with photorealistic textures.
